changelog: Note: this briefing asked for v3.17.1, but that version had already shipped (banner removal + streak typo fix) by the time this work started -- shipped as v3.17.2 instead, per the standing rule against reusing a version number

Add: registering a NEW trade is now blocked server-side while any trade limit is reached, not just via the frontend button state. New helpers.php::tradeLimitStatus() (extracted from CalculatorController::getRiskStatus(), shared) is called from TradeController::saveTrade() for add_trade only -- editing an existing trade (check-ins, planned_margin, notes, closing) is never blocked. Rejects with exactly {"success":false,"error":"STOP -- {reason}"} before any DB write, so it can't be bypassed from a stale open form, a second tab, or a direct API call

Fix: index.php's global topbar '+ Trade' button (present on every page, calls openTradeModal() directly) had no STOP gate at all -- only the Trades page's '+ New Trade' (via openChecklist()) did. Both buttons are now gated identically by js/trades.js::refreshNewTradeGate(), labelled with the literal 'STOP -- {reason}' text, called at app init so the topbar button is correct before the Trades page is ever visited. openTradeModal() itself also checks window._riskStopReason directly (guarded to only a brand-new trade, data=null), covering any future caller the same way

Amend: the calculator's STOP state no longer hides everything. Balance, Risk %, Margin in Use, Available Margin, the new Open Positions list, and the status strip all stay visible during a STOP -- only the stop%-dependent sizing numbers (risk, position, margin, quantity) and 'Use in Trade Form ->' disappear, replaced by the STOP message inside the Live Outputs card specifically

Add: Open Positions list on the calculator page (pair, direction, date, planned margin per row) -- exactly what the existing Margin in Use figure sums, now visible as line items, not just a total. Backed by a new open_positions field on get_risk_status, computed from the same query as margin_in_use/available_margin
